Title: Azure IoT Edge 1.0.8 release is now available

Body.Content:
The 1.0.8 version of Azure IoT Edge includes the following improvements below. Full release notes can be found on the GitHub release page for 1.0.8.

  • Preview support for ARM64 on Linux
  • Module twins are now encrypted at rest when cached on an IoT Edge device
  • Performance improvements for uploading messages from Edge Hub to the cloud
  • Increased reliability for syncing twin updates with the cloud
  • Improved stability on ARM32

 

​Instructions on how to update IoT Edge can be found here.
